instruction: Guide me on configuring VLC to save recordings in /home/user/Documents rather than the default folder.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.verification: The task follows the same pattern as the original: launch VLC, navigate to preferences, and change a specific configuration setting. The evaluator reads the vlcrc config file to verify the input-record-path setting is set to /home/user/Documents.
